scripts.build-copy:server: cd .. && cd server && yarn install --production && yarn build && cp -r ./build/ ../deploy/
scripts.build-copy:client: cd .. && cd client && yarn install --production && yarn build && cp -r ./build/ ../deploy/client
scripts.build-copy:server--windows: cd .. && cd server && yarn install && yarn build && cp -r ./build/. ../deploy/server/
scripts.build-copy:client--windows: cd .. && cd client && yarn install && yarn build && cp -r ./build/. ../deploy/client/
